records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the six months ended June 30, 2021, we generated approximately 39% of our total revenue from regions outside of the United States.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Subscription revenue increased $29.6 million, or 16.7%, for the three months ended June 30, 2021 as compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In addition, this seasonality is reflected in changes in our deferred revenue balance, which generally is impacted by the timing of when we enter into agreements with new customers, invoice customers, and recognize revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Free cash flow for the three and six months ended June 30, 2021 was $36.2 million and $105.6 million, respectively, resulting in free cash flow margins of 16.9% and 24.9%, as compared to free cash flows of $15.3 million and $13.0 million and free cash flow margins of 8.3% and 3.9%, for the same periods in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities for the three and six months ended June 30, 2021 was $45.3 million and $123.4 million, respectively, as compared to $22.8 million and $28.8 million during the same periods in 2020.
